children: Endovia Health Sciences closed an initial $500,000 secured convertible debt tranche to advance development and commercialization of CannEpil.
Closed $500,000 initial tranche of a previously announced $1M C/M Capital commitment to fund CannEpil development.
Proceeds to support FDA-regulated veterinary program (INAD No. 14145) targeting cancer-related pain in companion animals.
Funding also intended to advance international commercialization and potential licensing or acquisition opportunities.
Company cites recent FDA initiative and proposed H.R. 10150 (12-year exclusivity for qualifying botanical drugs) as supportive regulatory backdrop.
